SELECT
  cohort_year,
  count(*) AS cohort_size,
  sumIf(1, last_year > cohort_year) AS returned_customers,
  sumIf(1, last_year > cohort_year) * 1.0 / count(*) AS retention_fraction
FROM (
  SELECT
    CustomerKey,
    toYear(min(DateKey)) AS cohort_year,
    toYear(max(DateKey)) AS last_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year
